log_text: On 17/01/2025, the top drive displayed fault code FLT-0521 due to gearbox oil running over temperature. A gearbox oil change was carried out to address the issue. After the maintenance, the top drive was tested and found to be functioning correctly, returning to service. Logged by Lars Eriksen.

log_text: MUD-PUMP-02 had FLT-0417 showing up on the panel this morning, which turned out to be a worn liner causing low discharge pressure. I did a liner changed out and got the pressure back up to spec. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. 14 March 2052, SM.

extracted.fault_description: worn liner causing low discharge pressure

log_text: DRAWWORKS1 experienced FLT-0815 due to drum encoder signal dropping out. Recalibrated the drum encoder and the fault has cleared, job closed out. 20/03/2025. Logged by Patel.

February 21, 2025. Worked on DRAWWORKS-01, which showed FLT-0802 on the panel indicating the brake pads were worn beyond limit. New brake pads fitted and everything checked out, so the unit is back in service and running normally. Just hoping it holds up through the next few shifts.

extracted.fault_description: brake pads were worn beyond limit

log_text: On 31/02/2025, I worked on MUD-PUMP-04 which was displaying fault code FLT-0392. The issue was a leaking piston seal at the fluid end, so I replaced the seal. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. Logged by Tom Hallworth.

extracted.fault_description: leaking piston seal at the fluid end
